The proposed Hybrid Layout + Continuation Resolver eliminates cross-question contamination (from 23.83% to 0.0%) and achieves 100.0% answer coverage and slot accuracy.

reported_value: Stream D MAE: 12.4324 -> Stream D-Hybrid MAE: 11.6892 (Delta = -0.7432)

claim_statement: HSV red-ink extraction successfully isolates examiner annotations with 89.94% recall and preserves 99.86% of student blue/black pen strokes.

The Unified Rubric Hybrid Grader significantly outperforms single-modality lexical TF-IDF (MAE 1.6757 vs 3.6595 on conceptual Q1) and pure symbolic verifiers.
